evidence.claim: ZF Automotive Italia fa parte del gruppo ZF, che fornisce sistemi dinamici per auto, veicoli commerciali e tecnologia industriale, con 162 stabilimenti produttivi in 29 paesi.
evidence.quote: ZF is a global technology company supplying highly advanced dynamic systems for passenger cars, commercial vehicles and industrial technology. || The company operates 162 production locations in 29 countries. || Its comprehensive product range primarily serves vehicle manufacturers, mobility providers and start-up companies in the fields of transportation and mobility.
